method: Two L2-regularised logistic regression baselines, fitted locally with deterministic gradient descent.
observationPolicy: One sampled in-flight observation per request, from submission through 65% of its illustrative target. Future events are excluded from features. Completed cases are excluded from forecast evaluation; previously returned cases are also excluded from return forecast evaluation.

split.method: Chronological whole-request holdout; training cases purged unless outcomes matured before test submissions; normalisation fitted on training only.

delay.label: Completion exceeds the request’s illustrative calendar-hour target
delay.targetBasis: Calendar elapsed time; not an Emirates SLA

return.label: A correction return occurs before completion; forecast only while no return is observed

limitations: Generated labels and patterns are not evidence of Emirates performance or judge-test accuracy.
Displayed probabilities are uncalibrated synthetic baseline estimates; real-data calibration and validation are required.
No business calendars, external HR systems or employee-sensitive features are used.
Training assumes a complete event log; missing events, changed processes and out-of-distribution requests can reduce reliability.
Grade or department comparisons missing from the position register are encoded as zero and disclosed.
Observed overdue, returned and completed states are facts, not model predictions.
leakageControls: Whole requests remain in one chronological partition.
Training normalisation and weights never use the held-out partition.
Feature extraction ignores all events after the observation timestamp.
Final duration, final outcome and future return reasons are never model features.
Forecast metrics exclude outcomes already known at observation time.
